name: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk.
summary: PT Bukalapak.com Tbk. operates as a leading e-commerce platform throughout Indonesia, providing a comprehensive selection of merchandise. Its extensive inventory spans diverse categories including sporting equipment, motorcycles, and bicycles; consumer electronics like mobile phones and computers; hobby and collectible items; health and beauty products; fashion for men, women, and children; home essentials, groceries, and baby supplies; photography gear, industrial goods, and office stationery. The marketplace also features various digital products such as tickets, vouchers, games, and media, alongside precious metals, automobiles, and their related parts and accessories. Beyond its core retail operations, the company is actively involved in programming, information technology, and telecommunications activities. It also specializes in the creation and distribution of broadcast content, manages entertainment and talent agencies, and handles the planning, production, import, and supply of creative works like films, music, and animation. Furthermore, Bukalapak offers educational services, specifically private tutoring and counseling, in addition to transportation management, advertising solutions, IT consulting, software development, and a spectrum of financial services, which encompass the administration of non-insurance and pension funds, as well as mutual fund trading. Established in 2010, the company maintains its headquarters in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
